walkthroughs.body_html:
Comparative Study (HL Extension) — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Comparative Study (HL Extension) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Comparative Study (HL Extension).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Who developed iconological method in Studies in Iconology 1939?
options: Heinrich Wolfflin
Erwin Panofsky
Alois Riegl
Aby Warburg

mcqs.q: Whose 1998 Art and Agency treats artworks as social agents?
options: Bourdieu
Gell
Baxandall
Belting

mcqs.q: What attitude does Pop Art take toward consumer culture?
options: It straightforwardly celebrates capitalism.
It rejects all modern imagery.
Realistic depictions of everyday life.
Ambiguous - it both celebrates and critiques mass media imagery.

mcqs.q: What is the rule of thirds?
options: A guideline placing key elements along lines or intersections of a 3x3 grid.
A strict mathematical rule that must never be broken.
Using exactly three colours.
It rejects all modern imagery.
The unconscious mind, dreams, and Freudian psychology.
Using exactly three colours.
Realistic depictions of everyday life.
Random nonsense without intent.
